## Top stories

- Bangladesh and the World Bank have signed a $450 million agreement to strengthen the country's financial sector safety net and support banking reforms. This financing is intended to improve supervision and bolster the stability of financial institutions. (The Daily Star)
- The HSC and equivalent exam results for 2026 reveal a pass rate of 52.12%, the lowest in 22 years, with nearly half of the candidates failing. In contrast, cadet colleges maintained a 100% pass rate, with over 94% of their students achieving GPA-5. (Prothom Alo / BBC Bangla)
- Bangladesh has secured a three-year deferment for its graduation from the Least Developed Country (LDC) category. This extension provides the nation additional time to prepare for the economic transitions associated with moving out of the LDC status. (Banglanews24)
- South Africa has ascended to the top of the Test Team Rankings after defeating Australia by 176 runs to clinch their Test series 2-1. Simon Harmer led the charge with a career-best bowling performance of 6-16 in the final match. (Al Jazeera / ICC)
- Students who failed in one or two subjects in the HSC exams will be given a chance to sit for supplementary exams in December. Authorities aim to release these results quickly so that successful candidates do not miss out on university admission opportunities. (Jagonews24 / Prothom Alo)
- The readymade garment (RMG) sector in Bangladesh is facing a $4.8 billion shortfall in green investment needed for sustainable manufacturing between 2025 and 2029. This funding gap threatens to undermine the industry's competitiveness in global markets. (The Daily Star)

## AI

- OpenAI has reportedly lowered the funding target for its latest investment round as it struggles to meet initial expectations. (TechCrunch AI)
- A developer built a DIY "AI Tamagotchi" ahead of Meta's planned release of the Muse Charm, a portable AI helper designed to be carried as a toy. (The Verge AI)
- New malware is reportedly using Large Language Models (LLMs) to analyze and rank victims based on their financial worth to prioritize targets for theft. (Hacker News)
- An AI startup reportedly hacked Anthropic in just 12 hours, gaining access to internal employee messages and sensitive details. (Hacker News)

## Business

- Analysts suggest Britain’s housing crisis cannot be fixed without a new tax landscape that stops treating property primarily as a store of wealth. (The Guardian Business)
- Once Upon a Farm has issued a recall for its "Tractor Wheels" soft-baked snack bars following reports of a choking hazard for toddlers. (NYT Business)
- The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) brokers have submitted a proposal seeking tax exemptions on capital gains until the year 2030. (The Daily Star)
- A new report claims the Trump administration provided $950 million and pollution exemptions to nearly half of the coal plants in the United States. (The Guardian Business)
- UK Chancellor John Healey's budget includes a new focus on ringfencing preventative projects where future savings are expected to outweigh initial costs. (The Guardian Business)

## Tech

- A former Meta researcher was caught torrenting pirated books for a dataset but deleted the files due to ongoing litigation. (Hacker News)
- North Korean hackers are reportedly intensifying cyberattacks on major crypto exchanges like Binance to generate foreign currency for the country. (Prothom Alo)
- Meta faced criticism after suspending the Instagram account of a US Senate candidate during a live political rally. (Hacker News)
- A retired professor in Philadelphia was arrested for intentionally blocking a delivery robot and has stated she intends to do it again. (Hacker News)
- Tech stocks saw a downturn following a specific filing from the AI safety and research company Anthropic. (Hacker News)

## Bangladesh

- West Indies defeated Bangladesh by eight wickets in the first Test match held in Mirpur, dominating the hosts on the final day. (Al Jazeera)
- Six people were killed by a lightning strike while fishing in a marsh in the Malanchi union of Pabna. (Prothom Alo)
- The bodies of five migrant workers from Naogaon, who died in a factory fire in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, returned home 82 days after the incident. (Prothom Alo)
- A new gamma irradiation center has been inaugurated in Gazipur, which the government hopes will significantly boost agricultural exports. (The Daily Star)
- Police in Cumilla detained 236 individuals during an anti-teen-gang operation; 129 were later released to their families on bond. (Prothom Alo)
- Violence and land grabs continue to cause concern, with reports showing 109 people killed in political violence over the last nine months. (IANS LIVE / Prothom Alo)

## Education & Admission

- Despite the overall low pass rate in the HSC exams, experts note that university seats will remain vacant as the total number of passing students is less than half the available capacity. (The Daily Ittefaq)
- Educational institutions run by the Bangladesh Army achieved a high pass rate of 96.51% in this year's HSC examinations. (Kaler Kantho)
- The government is considering taking administrative action against teachers from schools that recorded a zero percent pass rate in the HSC exams. (Dainik Shiksha)
- President Sahabuddin has urged universities to shift their focus toward job-oriented education to address unemployment. (Dainik Amader Barta)
- Failure rates were highest in English and ICT subjects in this year’s HSC and equivalent examinations. (Banglanews24)

## Scholarships

- **Women in Ocean Food Innovation Studio 2027:** An equity-free business support program for female founders in the blue economy; applications close November 7, 2026. (Opportunity Desk)
- **Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po 2027:** Fully-funded Master’s scholarships for African students; applications close December 14, 2026. (Opportunity Desk)
- **IREX Community Solutions Program (CSP) 2026-2027:** A professional leadership development program for community leaders; deadline is November 24, 2026. (Opportunity Desk)
- **MIT Summer Research Program (MSRP) 2027:** A competitive summer initiative with stipends available to prepare students for graduate education; deadline January 19, 2027. (Opportunity Desk)
- **Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at AUC:** Full scholarships for the Spring 2027 semester at the American University of Cairo; deadline November 2, 2026. (Opportunity Desk)

## What to watch

- **HSC Supplementary Dates:** Students should look out for the official schedule for one or two-subject supplementary exams, expected to be finalized by November 3. (Prothom Alo)
- **Global Conflict Risks:** Analysts are warning of a potential shift toward a third world war as tensions escalate in Ukraine, the Middle East, and East Asia. (Prothom Alo)
- **DR Congo Ebola Outbreak:** The situation in DR Congo remains critical as the deadliest outbreak on record has killed more than 5,000 people. (BBC World)
- **U.S.-Cuba Diplomacy:** Keep an eye on Panama as it offers to host neutral ground for talks between the U.S. and Cuba in 2026. (inkl)
